_comment_mail_junk: Autonomous junk-flagging (stage 1 of email triage): every mail_junk_scan_interval_seconds, unread INBOX mail is scored by assistant/core/junk_filter.py and anything scoring at or above mail_junk_score_threshold is moved to the Junk folder. Not gated behind a confirmation -- it's reversible (moved, not deleted) and the whole point is that it runs unattended.
_comment_kroger_sync: Every kroger_sync_interval_seconds, kitchen_db.sync_kroger_orders checks for a newly-placed Kroger order and folds its items into kitchen inventory. Only ever finds something if the cart was built through Jarvis (chat or add_recipe_to_cart) and then checked out AND marked placed -- Kroger's API has no permission to report a trip made independently on Kroger's own app/site, so this covers a narrow case, not everyday Kroger shopping (use record_purchase or a receipt scan for that).
_comment_watchdog: The watchdog (scheduler.py's run_task_watchdog/run_review_watchdog, see docs/watchdog-system-design.md): every task_watchdog_interval_seconds, a personal task whose due_at has arrived gets notified directly (mechanical, no LLM call). Every review_watchdog_interval_seconds, any pending Review item older than review_watchdog_stale_hours -- including a sensitive-tool confirmation like a PR ready to merge -- gets a short handle_message-generated nudge, so the owner finds out the item is still waiting instead of only noticing when he happens to check.
_comment_llm_backend: 'ollama' runs on the local model; 'claude_cli' runs on the Claude Code CLI (and so the user's claude.ai subscription). Switching is this one line.
_comment_claude_tools_api_key: Authenticates the MCP bridge subprocess to /api/tools/call. Equivalent to full owner access - anything holding it can invoke every Jarvis tool.
_comment_business: Omit this whole block and the business/second-in-command side stays off — no tools, no agents, no digest. Nothing here belongs in code: the predecessor project hardcoded its city and the module died when the business moved.

business.name: YOUR BUSINESS NAME
business.notes: Any standing context the research agents should know.

_comment_gpu_bridge: simrig as a shared inference resource for agent work that doesn't need Claude (image analysis, bulk text). Queued, model-routed, and released to the owner the moment he says he's gaming or racing. gpu_task_models overrides the task->model routing; put model choices here, not in code, because they age in weeks.
_comment_comfy: ComfyUI on the GPU box for image (Z-Image Turbo) and video (Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B) generation. A separate server from Ollama on the same machine. Omit comfy_host and image/video jobs fail with a clear message instead of running.
_comment_business_agents: Master switch for unattended agent runs. Off means nothing fires on a timer; agents still run on demand from chat.
_comment_personal_research: How often the background agent checks for personal errands ('find me a dentist') to research. Not gated behind business_agents_enabled — this runs regardless.
_comment_github: Dev-team agents: git branch/push/PR tools and the ops-plan/SSH workflow. Use a fine-grained PAT scoped to just this one repo (Contents + Pull requests, read/write) — not a classic token with broader access.
_comment_ssh_hosts: Named hosts the ops-plan workflow may target — short name to {host, user, key_path or password}. The model only ever refers to a host by its short name; real address/credential stay server-side.
